offers_products.reason: It leases Gamma Knife and radiation therapy equipment to hospitals under financing arrangements; equipment is not sold as goods.

offers_services.reason: Provides equipment financing and leasing, plus feasibility studies and planning support, for hospitals' radiosurgery and radiation therapy programs.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are hospital and medical center partners, not individual patients, who are billed by the hospitals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Hospitals and medical centers are its partners and buyers of radiosurgery equipment financing.

recurring_revenue.reason: Multi-year leases and per-procedure arrangements with hospitals for radiosurgery equipment give ongoing revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Cancer and brain tumor treatment is medical care that hospitals keep providing in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Hospitals pay over time through leases or per-procedure fees, not one large purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from financed equipment assets, not its staff's time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual hospitals and medical centers, not mainly large enterprises or government agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: It invests its own capital in expensive Gamma Knife and proton therapy equipment placed at hospitals.
